evidence.source: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Multi-function Chinese Character Database
evidence.field: 漢字甲骨部件分析; 月 entry
evidence.text: The entry describes oracle-bone and bronze forms as a half-moon pictograph with ‘moon’ as the original meaning. It gives an oracle-bone eclipse example, 合集11483正, and Shang oracle-bone and bronze examples using 月 for calendar months: 合集5658正 and 曶鼎. It connects the month use to the moon’s waxing and waning cycle; the page does not independently establish that one Shang use predates the other.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：漢字甲骨部件分析

evidence.source: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Multi-function Chinese Character Database; citing 裘錫圭
evidence.field: 漢字甲骨部件分析; 月 and 夕 discussion
evidence.text: The entry reports that 月 and 夕 once shared a moon-shaped graph, with a dot inside or absent not initially distinguishing the forms; it says graphic specialization later associated the dotted form with 月 and the undotted form with 夕. This is a reported graphic-development account, not evidence that either graph is phonetic in the other.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：漢字甲骨部件分析

evidence.field: File description; summary, source, permission, and original-file link
evidence.text: The page identifies this as a modern SVG rendering of 月 in Shang oracle script, not an artifact photograph. It attributes the depicted form to Sinica record 42.EEB0 (簠天1, 合33694, 歷組) and states the Sinica image is CC0 1.0. The exact original-file link resolves to https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/94/%E6%9C%88-oracle.svg; the web tool could not render the SVG because of its image content type.

search_audit.outcome: Inspected the CUHK entry, which separately reports moon and calendar-month uses in Shang material. The Sage result concerns month-graph positioning and does not resolve word origin.

search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:月-oracle.svg 月 oracle script SVG; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:月-bronze.svg 月 bronze SVG
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the exact Commons descriptions. Oracle candidate page provided provenance, attribution to Sinica form 42.EEB0, and CC0 notice; its direct image request could not be rendered by the web tool, but the exact linked URL was exposed. Bronze candidate identity was established but its reuse details and direct URL were not sufficiently verified.

gaps: The exact first dated attestation of 月 was not established: CUHK supplies oracle-bone and bronze catalogue examples, but this pass did not independently date or inspect the artifacts.
The inspected CUHK page reports both ‘moon’ and calendrical-month uses in Shang material. Their relative chronology is not established here; gloss order should not be treated as chronology.
No dated first occurrence was verified for moonlight, monthly, round-object, classifier, or surname senses. The inspected sources do not establish those links in detail.
The exact date and mechanism of the 月/夕 graphic specialization are not established by the consulted pages; the account is reported by CUHK with attribution to Qiu Xigui.
Word-family proposals in the dossier involving Proto-Sino-Tibetan, Tibetan ngo, 越, 外, 歲, and the proposed lost word in 名 were not independently investigated or endorsed in this pass.
The supplied local Unihan kMandarin and Baxter–Sagart rows were not verified against their upstream sources during this pass; preserve them as local findings only.

The oracle SVG’s original image link was verified from its Commons description page, but the web tool refused to display the SVG due to unsupported image content type. The candidate remains proposed because the page establishes its identity, source record, and rights.
The 月-bronze.svg candidate was not selected because sufficient reuse details and an exact direct image URL were not verified.

items.period: Shang oracle-bone script; source record is identified as 簠天1, 合33694, 歷組
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of a Shang oracle-script form of 月, sourced by the file description to Sinica record 42.EEB0.
items.alt: A modern black-line rendering of an early 月 graph, identified as Shang oracle script.
items.selection_reason: Shows an early form relevant to the supported half-moon pictographic account and has an inspected source page with specific Sinica record provenance and CC0 rights.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication, as stated on the Commons page for the Sinica-derived image.

items.period: Shuowen small-seal script tradition; the image is a modern vector reconstruction
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 月 in Shuowen seal-script style, useful for comparison with the early oracle-script form.
items.alt: A modern black-line rendering of 月 in seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides a later standardized script-style comparison against the oracle-script candidate; the Commons page identifies the graph and its source collections and publishes a public-domain dedication.
items.rights: Public domain dedication for the SVG representation, as stated on the Commons file page.

limitations.text: Neither selected asset is an ancient artifact photograph; both are modern vector redrawings of historical script forms. The oracle file page links its form to Sinica record 42.EEB0, but the image pixels were not visually inspected in this research stage.
